title: Blood Manipulation
subtitle: Drawing on what is already there
text: Manipulation is the act of giving form to what already lives in the blood. It does not create power from nothing — it directs power that was always present, seeded by the infection and bound to a tendency. Manipulations are ranked HUMILIS (first learning), MEDIOCRITAS (practiced), and SUMMA (mastered). They are typed: QUICK (a single act), PASSIVE (always active), CONTINUOUS (active while held), or CHARGED (building toward release). All draw from your blood reserve. Each is bound to a vein section — that section bears the strain.
